stations.title: Ambrose
stations.say: Can the laptop print our card?
stations.note: The card hangs in the window.

stations.title: Workshop laptop
stations.text: Prints a good morning and an old offer.

stations.title: Window card
stations.text: Printed and ready for the window.

captions: First day at Tolliver Clockworks. Ambrose wants the laptop to print the window card.
Today the laptop prints a good morning and an offer they stopped, but no card.
You write the lines that print it, build them with the compiler, in four tasks.
Now the welcome and the hours print, and the old offer is switched off.
One file, built and run in the terminal. The laptop talks, and the card is in the window.
